title: Protesters Demand Release of Iguala Detainees, Accuse FGR of Fabricating Charges
detail: Demonstrators in Iguala demanded the release of the individuals detained on June 23 in connection with the funeral-home cremation investigation, arguing the FGR fabricated charges against them and that federal agents did not present arrest warrants when detaining members of the Rueda Mazón family. Protesters also alleged crematory ovens had been installed at the site where none previously existed, raising fresh doubts among some local residents about the credibility of the government's new investigative line — a criticism families of the 43 had already voiced in April 2026.

media.caption: Iguala residents demand release of detainees in the funeral-home cremation case
